mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 70 degrees at Verona City Hall under overcast skies with a Third Quarter moon. The air quality index is 51, so keep that in mind, and we expect an overnight low of 66 with no rain in the forecast.

The city is currently accepting applications for seasonal positions with the Recreation Department, including adult fitness instructors, and the senior center is promoting their tri-shaw bike program for scenic rides on the Military Ridge State Trail.
We have a busy few days ahead starting with live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, the Dane County Farmers Market on Friday, and the girls try hockey event this Saturday.
In our weekly police report, on Thursday, July 31st, officers conducted a traffic stop that led to an arrest for O W I after observing a vehicle with no active taillights and a flat tire.
The flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM tomorrow.
